title: Identify a Specific Immune Profile in Patients With Chronic Pelvic Pain Resistant to First-line Treatments by Measuring Th1, Th2, Th17, and Treg Cytokines Produced After Non-specific Functional Cell Stimulation - ImmunoCPP
official: Identify a Specific Immune Profile in Patients With Chronic Pelvic Pain Resistant to First-line Treatments by Measuring Th1, Th2, Th17, and Treg Cytokines Produced After Non-specific Functional Cell Stimulation - ImmunoCPP
summary: Chronic pelvic pain (CPP) affects more than one in four women. An immune imbalance in the Th1/Th2 balance has been reported in multiple CPP situations, particularly in patients with endometriosis, but with mixed results. The use of a functional immune test, already validated in previous indications and particularly in infertility, could simulate an immune stimulation similar to that of painful attacks.
